mapper.select: SELECT checkin_id, user_id, checkin_date, streak, points_earned, create_time FROM bbs_checkin WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY checkin_date DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bbs_checkin (user_id, checkin_date, streak, points_earned, create_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{checkinDate}, #{streak}, #{pointsEarned}, now())
